summary.text: Ralph Foster is the Republican candidate for Montana House of Representatives District 15 in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the June 2 Republican primary; the incumbent, Thedis Crowe, is the Democratic candidate.

paragraphs.text: Ralph Foster was born in Ironton, Missouri, and earned an associate degree from Fort Hays State University in 1984.
His career experience includes working as a funeral director.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, he said he was born in the Ozarks in 1962, has lived in Montana since finishing college, and that he and his wife own and run a funeral business on both the Blackfeet and Flathead Reservations.
Foster ran for Montana House District 15 in 2022, losing to incumbent Marvin Weatherwax Jr., and again in 2024, losing to Thedis Crowe.

In the 2024 survey he described himself as a fiscal conservative and listed legislator accountability, cutting state spending to reduce the need for higher property taxes, and relations between tribes and state government among his priorities.
